title: DeFake Project
shortDescription: DeFake is a project aimed at developing deepfake detection solutions for journalists, forensic experts, and law enforcement agencies by focusing on usability, explainability, and robustness.

title: Dungeons & Deepfakes
shortDescription: A novel scenario-based role-playing training simulation to teach deepfake detection skills to journalists and media professionals.

title: Varuna Project
shortDescription: Varuna is a tool that uses AI to detect deepfakes and manipulated media.
